name: narasimhaponnada-mermaid-mcp
description: AI-powered Mermaid diagram generation with 22+ diagram types including flowcharts, sequence diagrams, class diagrams, ER diagrams, architecture diagrams, state machines, and more. Features 50+ pre-built templates, advanced layout engines, SVG/PNG/PDF exports, and seamless integration with GitHub Copilot, Claude, and any MCP-compatible client. Install via NPM: `npm install -g @narasimhaponnada/mermaid-mcp-server`
